Market today: The market mood is sour, driven by rising Treasury yields hitting multi-year highs and concerns about a potential AI slowdown. China's economic struggles are adding to global growth worries. This environment is tough for your tech/chip heavy, margin-fueled book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-60.26%) and SPAL (-33.64%) are flashing "SELL" and are leveraged, meaning drops are amplified. SMH (-14.91%) is also on "TRIM" and very close to its stop. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield for any further spikes, and monitor news around AI demand and China's economic health.

Bottom line: Aggressively manage risk in your leveraged and underperforming tech/chip positions.
plays: SOXL and SPAL are flagged "SELL" with deep losses. Consider reducing exposure or setting tight, active stops on these leveraged ETFs to protect capital.
SMH is on "TRIM" and trading right at its 540 stop. Respect that level to prevent further losses in this chip ETF.
If you're looking to hedge or play further downside in semis, the scanner has a "WATCH" setup for SOXS (entry 50.55-50.5, stop 50.07).
